family.description: This entry represents the N-terminal domain of proteins described as cilia- and flagella-associated protein. Proteins containing this domain includes FAP61 from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii. FAP61 is part of the calmodulin and spoke-associated complex (CSC) required for wild-type motility and for the stable assembly of a subset of radial spokes in motile cilia [[cite:PUB00076499]].
family.name: Cilia- and flagella-associated protein 61, N-terminal domain
